chunks: Those who disbelieve and obstruct (others) from the way of God will have wasted their deeds.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the deeds of those who disbelieve and obstruct others from God's path?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to mean that the good deeds of disbelievers are not merely lost but actively nullified due to the barrier they create against divine guidance, emphasizing the link between belief and action. It underscores the principle that faith without the propagation of truth leads to spiritual futility, a concept central to the Shia understanding of the relationship between the Imams and the community.
